title.zh: 抵达西安：先认准到达点
title.ja: 西安到着：まず駅と空港を確認
title.en: ARRIVING IN XI'AN · NAME THE HUB FIRST

wei_river.note: Generalized Wei River orientation only; not survey geometry or a navigation feature.

walled_core.note: Generalized rectangle for the Ming-walled city core, not a surveyed wall polygon or hotel boundary.

core_anchor.note: Bell Tower position is used as a stable core anchor, not as the destination of every arrival.

hubs.note: Aerodrome centroid from OpenStreetMap; terminal paths are explained in official airport material rather than inferred from this point.
Station-building centroid from OpenStreetMap; plaza, exit, and pickup choice remains a signed on-site decision.
Station-building centroid from OpenStreetMap; the map does not prescribe a north or south exit.
Station-building centroid from OpenStreetMap; the official opening report controls the current transfer claim.

spines.note: Simplified airport-to-Xi'an-North decision spine; not track geometry, stops, time, or live service.
Simplified north-south decision spine from Xi'an North through the central corridor; not full Line 2 geometry.
Simplified Line 4 decision spine linking Xi'an North and Xi'an Station before continuing south; not full track geometry.
Simplified westward decision spine from the new Xi'an East transfer; not a full Line 5 route or guarantee of a particular interchange.

cards.title: AIRPORT
cards.zh: 先看航站楼，再选14号线或有标识的乘车区。
cards.ja: ターミナルを確認し、14号線か指定乗車場所へ。
cards.en: TERMINAL FIRST · THEN LINE 14 OR SIGNED PICKUP

cards.title: XI'AN NORTH
cards.zh: 2、4、14号线交会；按住处方向选，不默认2号线。
cards.ja: 2・4・14号線。宿の方向で選び、2号線に固定しない。
cards.en: LINES 2 / 4 / 14 · CHOOSE FOR THE HOTEL SIDE

cards.title: XI'AN STATION
cards.zh: 这是城墙北侧的西安站，不是西安北站。
cards.ja: 城壁北側の西安駅。西安北駅とは別の駅。
cards.en: BY THE NORTH WALL · NOT XI'AN NORTH

cards.title: XI'AN EAST
cards.zh: 2026年6月开站；沿标识步行换5号线，当日复核。
cards.ja: 2026年6月開業。案内に従って5号線へ。当日再確認。
cards.en: NEW IN 2026 · FOLLOW SIGNS TO LINE 5 · RECHECK

sources.title: OpenStreetMap pinned positions for Xi'an arrival hubs

visual_qa.notes: Inspected at the 5600 x 5040 master, a 1476-pixel B6-width 300 dpi proof, and a 900-pixel mobile zoom proof matching the website's 2.5x map control. All four hubs, four line spines, three language layers, and four decision cards remain distinct; no line claims a full route or live service.
